name: Tangled Stars
source:
Ladia, the one country everyone wants to live in, because  "There is nothing but equality and peace amongst other kins and humans surrounding you everywhere you go."

No matter where you live on the globe, you'd hear about this eutopia every day on the news, about how the two races "aid each other" and do "heroic acts for one another".
However, like in everything else, the surface hides what lies underneath...

Jonah never liked the lies people tell on TV, ever since he was at a very young age, because he saw the truth, he saw the murderous hate the two have for each other, he saw how isolated he was from people because of it.
He hated it.

However, all of this switches when the stars start to shift around, making the gears of fate turn, and change in winds is inevitable.

Watch Jonah's story unfold as he meets the beauties of the world along with its deeper meanings, while trying to escape the darkness' claws that crave to drag him into its depths. 

[From [url=https://deejayyy.itch.io/tangled-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拉迪亚是人人向往的国度，因为“无论走到哪里，周围的人类与异族之间都只有平等与和平”。

无论你住在世界何处，每天都能从新闻里听说这片乐土，听说两个种族如何“互帮互助”，如何“为了彼此做出英勇之举”。
然而，正如其他许多事物一样，表象之下还藏着另一面……

约拿从小就不喜欢电视上那些人的谎言。因为他亲眼见过真相，见过两个种族对彼此恨不得除之而后快的仇视，也见过自己因此遭受的孤立。
他厌恶这一切。

然而，随着星辰移转，命运的齿轮开始转动，一切都将改变，风向的转变已不可避免。

跟随约拿的故事，见证他发现世界的美好与更深的意义，同时努力摆脱黑暗的利爪——它正渴望将他拖入深渊。

[摘自[url=https://deejayyy.itch.io/tangled-stars]itch.io[/url]]
